values.note: FS: 26 sites, 17 reservable and 9 first-come; max RV 35 ft; 'A few sites offer level pull-throughs.' recreation.gov's catalog lists 25 (no site 003), per-site maximum vehicle lengths 22-40 ft (most 24-32; site 007 40, site 018 22), 6 pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/east-fork-campground ('26 sites: 17 reservable 9 first-come, first-served'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; 'A few sites offer level pull-throughs') + recreation.gov catalog for 233269 (25 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 22-40), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233269 (all 25 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/east-fork-campground ('Vault Toilet (3)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + recreation.gov 233269 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: May through September (FS); the FS points to recreation.gov for exact dates.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/east-fork-campground ('Seasons of Use: May through September'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 17 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 9 first-come (FS). 2026 reservations ran May 8 - Sept 26; 2027 is posted as June 5 - Sept 26. recreation.gov allows 28 nights in a rolling 60 days. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; up to 8 people a site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/east-fork-campground ('17 reservable 9 first-come, first-served'; 'Check-in time: 2:00 pm'; 'Maximum number of people per site: 8') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233269 (maxStay 28, Rolling 60 Days) and /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-26; 2027-06-05 to 2027-09-26), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/east-fork-campground ('Single Site: $32 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233269/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32), read 2026-10-28

note: On a ridge above the East Fork San Juan among ponderosa and Gambel oak, ~11 mi NE of Pagosa Springs off Hwy 160 then 0.75 mi on FR 667; ~7,700 ft. Some sites look down on the river, which is a long way down; short, steep trails lead to the bank. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 233269 + catalog: confirmed 26 sites (17 reservable/9 FCFS), max RV 35 ft (FS), a few pull-throughs, no hookups, vault toilets, potable water, $32 (2026/2027), season May-September. Added booking.season 05-08..09-26 (2026), 28-night max (rec.gov). Phone missing: Pagosa RD (970) 264-2268. Pin at the site centroid. Note trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: Pagosa Ranger District Office (970) 264-2268, from the FS campground page. recreation.gov lists the concessionaire's numbers instead (facility phone 970-264-5255; 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420'; contact email @goexplorus.com).
Operator: recreation.gov's contact details point to a concessionaire (goexplorus.com), so the campground appears to be concession-run on San Juan NF land; ownership left federal.
Length conflict: FS 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; recreation.gov's catalog gives site 007 40 ft (others 22-34). Recorded 35. Site 018 is catalogued at 22 ft; every other site is 24 ft or more.

Waterfront (stored riverview): the FS page agrees - 'Although some sites look down to the river, the river is a long way down'; the campground is on a ridge above the East Fork. Consistent with riverview.
FS page header reads 'Site Closed' (2026-10-28): the ordinary end of the May-September season, not recorded as a status.
